title: "DVS_plot"
output: html_document

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Load data
full_df <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/NFL-WR-Route-Running-DVS-main/full_data.csv")
all_grid <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/NFL-WR-Route-Running-DVS-main/Methodology/Final Metrics Computation/Mike_Evans_grid_cov_2games.csv")

```

```{r}

game <- full_df %>%
  filter(game_id == 2023091004)

play <- game %>%
  filter(play_description == "(1:14) (Shotgun) B.Mayfield pass deep middle to M.Evans for 28 yards, TOUCHDOWN.")

play_description <- "(1:14) (Shotgun) B.Mayfield pass deep middle to M.Evans for 28 yards, TOUCHDOWN."

# 2. Extract play metadata
target_game <- 2023091004
target_play <- 2177

play_data <- full_df %>% 
  filter(game_id == target_game, play_id == target_play)

target_frame <- play_data %>%
  filter(phase == "pre_pass") %>%
  summarise(max_frame = max(frame_id, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(max_frame)

# 2. Extract ball landing location
# Checks for standardized vs raw ball land column names automatically
ball_land <- play_data %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  mutate(
    land_x = if ("ball_land_x_std" %in% names(.)) ball_land_x_std else ball_land_x,
    land_y = if ("ball_land_y_std" %in% names(.)) ball_land_y_std else ball_land_y
  )

# 3. Surface Heatmap (Strict NA drop to clean gray border boundaries)
static_surface <- all_grid %>% 
  filter(
    game_id == target_game, 
    play_id == target_play, 
    frame_id == target_frame, 
    in_target_zone == TRUE,
    !is.na(efficiency),
    efficiency > 0
  )

# 4. Player tracking data
static_players <- play_data %>% 
  filter(
    frame_id == target_frame,
    (nfl_id == 41233 | tolower(player_role) == "passer" | tolower(player_side) == "defense")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    player_side = tolower(player_side),
    dir_rad = dir_std * pi / 180,
    vx = s * sin(dir_rad),
    vy = s * cos(dir_rad)
  )

# 5. Extract Line of Scrimmage & First Down Markers
play_meta <- static_players %>% slice(1)
los <- play_meta$los_x_std
first_down <- los + play_meta$yards_to_go

# 6. Render Field Plot
p <- ggplot() +
  # Turf & Field lines
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 120, ymin = 0, ymax = 53.3, fill = "#1e7a3a") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 10, ymin = 0, ymax = 53.3, fill = "#135c29") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 110, xmax = 120, ymin = 0, ymax = 53.3, fill = "#135c29") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 5), color = "white", alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 10), color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Scrimmage & First Down
  geom_vline(xintercept = los, color = "black", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = first_down, color = "yellow", linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  # Coverage Efficiency Heatmap Layer (na.value hides background tiles)
  geom_tile(data = static_surface, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = efficiency), alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "white", mid = "lightpink", high = "#dc2626", 
    midpoint = 0.25, limits = c(0, 0.5), name = "Route Threat\nEfficiency",
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  
  # Ball Land Location Marker (Target / Pass Landing Point)
  geom_point(data = ball_land, aes(x = land_x, y = land_y), shape = 4, size = 5, stroke = 2, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = ball_land, aes(x = land_x, y = land_y), shape = 4, size = 4, stroke = 1.2, color = "#f97316") +
  
  # Player Velocity Segments
  geom_segment(
    data = static_players,
    aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, xend = x_std + vx * 1.5, yend = y_std + vy * 1.5, color = player_side),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # Player Points
  geom_point(data = static_players, aes(x = x_std, y = y_std), size = 4.5, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = static_players, aes(x = x_std, y = y_std, color = player_side), size = 3.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("offense" = "#facc15", "defense" = "#3b82f6"), name = "Side") +
  
  # Formatting
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, 120), ylim = c(0, 53.3)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Mike Evans Dangerous Viable Space at Time of Throw",
       subtitle = paste0(play_description))

p

ggsave(
  filename = "~/Documents/Sports Analytics/NFL-WR-Route-Running-DVS-main/Plots/Mike_Evans_TD_DVS_plot.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 8.5,
  height = 7.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```
